tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
创建笔记搜索前端页面

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and flexibility for future features.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Implement proper authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue to display and manage notes.
T3.notes: Focus on a user-friendly interface with responsive design.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search algorithm to query notes by keywords, tags, or date range.
T4.notes: Optimize the search for performance, especially with large datasets.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page with a search bar and filters to display search results dynamically.
T5.notes: Ensure real-time feedback and intuitive navigation for users.
